title: Larb gai (Thai minced chicken salad)
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet; toast 1 tbsp raw rice in a dry pan until golden and coarsely crush it in a mortar.
Finely chop the chicken and cook it with 3 tbsp water in a pan for 5–6 minutes until crumbly.
Remove from the heat and mix in the lime juice, fish sauce, chilli flakes, shallots, spring onions and herbs.
Sprinkle with the toasted rice powder and serve in lettuce leaves with cucumber and rice.
